government.note: Presidential republic under the 1987 (Sixth Republic) Constitution. The President is head of state and of government, directly elected by plurality for a single five-year term. The Prime Minister is appointed by the President with the consent of the National Assembly, directs the ministries and is first in line to act as President; when the post is vacant or the PM is suspended, a Deputy Prime Minister acts. Presidents impeached by the National Assembly are suspended until the Constitutional Court rules (Roh Moo-hyun 2004, reinstated; Park Geun-hye 2016-2017 and Yoon Suk Yeol 2024-2025, removed). A vacancy must be filled by an election within 60 days. The President can declare martial law.

system.note: Single-member constituencies by FPTP plus national list seats by largest remainder. Size: 299 seats in the 15th Assembly (1996-2000), 273 in 2000, 299 in 2004 and 2008, 300 since 2012 (254 constituency + 46 list since 2024). List seats go to parties with 3% of the list vote or five constituency seats (current Public Official Election Act). A 2019 reform made part of the list allocation compensatory, which led both main parties to run satellite lists in 2020 and 2024.

start_2000.ideology_support_note: Derived from the 1996 National Assembly vote (New Korea Party 34.5%, NCNP 25.3%, United Liberal Democrats 16.2%, United Democratic Party 11.2%, independents 11.9%, others 0.9%), adjusted towards the December 1997 presidential result (Kim Dae-jung 40.3%, Lee Hoi-chang 38.7%, Lee In-je 19.2%). NKP and most of the UDP (merged into the GNP in 1997) count as liberal conservative; the NCNP and Lee In-je's later merger into it as social liberal; the ULD as traditional conservative. Independents are spread over regionalist and big-tent support; the small labour left (the Democratic Labor Party was founded on 30 January 2000) gets a few points.

claims.note: Article 3 of the Constitution defines the territory of the Republic of Korea as the Korean Peninsula and its adjacent islands, which includes the area governed by North Korea.
